The '''Balmorran maweater''' was a creature native to an [[Unidentified Balmorran island chain|island chain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The maweater was so named because it was the primary predator of the [[Wingmaw/Legends|wingmaw]], another creature native to the island chain, and the two [[Species/Legends|species]] were unintentionally transplanted to the Balmorran mainland by unwary explorers around six hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the Great War. However, the maweaters were wiped out when the Sith Empire [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|bombarded]] the planet during the Great War, and as a result, the wingmaw population flourished and soon became a threat to both [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] and the planet's ecosystem.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balmorran maweaters were first mentioned in the Codex entry for wingmaws in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the codex their physical appearance was not described.<ref name="Codex" />
